, Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer misidentified the station closest to Cleveland Elementary School as Cleveland Park (Red Line), conflating “Cleveland Elementary” with “Cleveland Park.” This wrong station/line assumption led to concluding there was no same-line route to DCA and answering 0, instead of counting 8 Blue Line stops from the correct Blue Line station near the school (e.g., McPherson Square) to Reagan National Airport.
